title: Diodes and LEDs: direction, types, and uses

spans.text: A diode mainly allows current in one direction. An LED emits light; its longer lead is usually the anode and the shorter lead the cathode.

spans.caption: Diodes and LEDs: direction, types, and uses

spans.text: Use a series resistor with an LED. A diode's stripe usually marks the cathode; confirm the part's datasheet.
